rows.name:
Reku's little sister Kika is tiny but eats a ton-mo![XENO:n ]
At this rate, Reku will be the next Hero[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Eek! I don't even want to think about it-mo! Help me-mo!

Obtain 10 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Bone-In Leg Meat[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Deinos in Makna Forest.
Report to Reku.

This should keep Kika satisfied for a while-mo.[XENO:n ]
[XENO:line ]Probably.

The meat you brought before wasn't enough for Kika-mo.[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Now I have to ask everyone in the village-mo![XENO:n ]
'We help each other in hard times' is a handy phrase-mo.
Speak to the village's most dedicated Nopon researcher.
Speak to the strongest Nopon in the village.
Speak to the cutest Nopon in the village.
Report to Reku.

Thanks to everyone, Reku and Kika can live happily-mo.[XENO:n ]
That guy's definitely going to be Hero next year too-mo.

Kika's going to be the Hero-mo! I really, really will-mo![XENO:n ]
But I have to get much, much stronger first-mo.[XENO:n ]
Help Kika with her grand plan-mo~!

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Ansel Wings[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Makna Ansels in Makna Forest.
Report to Kika.

It's the magnificent Hero Kika's debut battle-mo![XENO:n ]
Make sure you come and watch-mo!

Because you agreed to Kika's request, sweet little Kika[XENO:n ]
now says she'll defeat a dangerous monster-mo.[XENO:n ]
Take responsibility and defeat it first-mo!

Near Fuudi Lair in Makna Forest,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Obsessive Galgaron[/System:Color].
Report to Reku.

Phew! The monster Kika said she'd defeat is gone-mo.[XENO:n ]
What a relief-mo.

Modanii can beat monsters in a flash-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
[XENO:line ]But those lizards are my one weakness-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
They hinder my training with Kika-ja-mo! Beat them-mo!

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Calor Deinos[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Tonitr Deinos[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Report to Modanii.

Kika! Let's train in the martial arts in Makna-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
Kika is definitely the future Hero-ja-mo~!
Quest B Completion Message

I've fussed over my little sister, with no romance-mo![XENO:n ]
This is bad-mo! Now there's nothing left but to have[XENO:n ]
you lot choose a wife for Reku-mo.

Speak to Pip or Lupa,[XENO:n ]
who apparently have feelings for Reku.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Delicious Vamp Tails[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Vamps in Makna Forest.
Report to Pip.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Royal Apis Nectar[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Apis in Makna Forest.
Report to Lupa.

Cute Pip is going to be my wife-mo.[XENO:n ]
They say she's terrifying when angry, but never mind-mo!

I'm dating mysterious Lupa with marriage in mind-mo![XENO:n ]
She's really cute without her mask-mo!

I love baking, but mixing is quite a chore-mo.[XENO:n ]
A tool to make it easier[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Make me one of those things called a mixer-mo.
Obtain materials for the mixer.

At the Weapon Dev. Lab in Colony 9,[XENO:n ]
assemble the mixer.
Report to Ron.

Gyugyuuun! Gyurururuun![XENO:n ]
I'll win Pip over with delicious sweets-mo.
Gather materials to make the mixer Ron wants.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Generic Shafts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Machine God Soldiers M64 on the Giant God's Leg.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Generic Blades[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Machine God Soldiers M53 on the Giant God's Leg.

You gathered the materials for the mixer.[XENO:n ]
Head to the Weapon Dev. Lab in Colony 9.

What Pip loves most is cute things-mo.[XENO:n ]
Living surrounded by cute things should make Pip[XENO:n ]
even cuter[XENO:line ] Hurry and gather them-mo!

Gather 6 [System:Color name=item ]Enigma Lotuses[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

Gather 4 [System:Color name=item ]Happy Rabbits[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.
Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Liebe Cranes[/System:Color][XENO:n ] in the Ether Mine.
Report to Pip.

Hee hee! Pip's room is cute now-mo.[XENO:n ]
I'm ready whenever my prince comes-mo.

Kirara's grandpa says bugs are his only friends.[XENO:n ]
I want him to make Nopon friends-mo.[XENO:n ]
Kirara wants to play with Grandpa Deku and his friends-mo~!
Find a Nopon that likes bugs.

Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Blue-Sky Stink Bugs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Give them to Ababa.
Report to Kirara.

Ababa says he'll be friends with Grandpa Deku![XENO:n ]
Kirara's happy Grandpa has a friend-mo.

Grr! That Ababa! How can he think[XENO:n ]
liking bugs means it's fine to eat them-ja-mo?![XENO:n ]
I'll make him suffer with his beloved bugs-mo!

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Spicy Eluca Juice[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Makna Elucas in Makna Forest.
Have Ababa drink it and see what he thinks.
Report to Deku.

That Ababa not only said bugs were delicious,[XENO:n ]
he offered some to Grandpa Deku! Unforgivable-mo!

I never expected Ababa to handle spicy food-mo.[XENO:n ]
Surely he can't stand really bitter things-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
This time I'll make him stop eating bugs-ja-mo~!

Obtain 5 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Bitter Lampus Fluid[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Colony Lampus in Colony 6.
Have Ababa drink it and see what he thinks.
Report to Deku.

Such depth of flavour beneath that bitterness[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
I've discovered an adult taste-ja-mo! Well done, Ababa-mo.

I want mushrooms-mo! Soft mushrooms-mo![XENO:n ]
I fondly remember the chief scolding me for nibbling[XENO:n ]
every mushroom as a youngster. My teeth are too bad now-mo.

Gather 8 [System:Color name=item ]Kelp Mushrooms[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Report to Fugofugo.

I got to eat my favourite mushrooms, but will I[XENO:n ]
never be able to eat anything chewy again-mo?

The dental treatment I devised[XENO:line ] Only someone like me,[XENO:n ]
who travelled far to study medicine, could think of it.[XENO:n ]
Help me prove that old-fashioned Yushi wrong!

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Ories Adamant Horns[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Ories on Valak Mountain.
Return to Medi.

Using such materials is an outrageous idea, even for me.[XENO:n ]
What an incredible talent I have[XENO:line ]

Yushi inherited Nopon medical arts as a doctor-ja-mo.[XENO:n ]
I want to help villagers with bad teeth, but[XENO:n ]
my leg hurts[XENO:line ] I won't lose to Medi-ja-mo!

Obtain 4 [System:Color name=item ]Vamp Milk Teeth[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Vamps in Satorl Marsh.
Report to Yushi.

The traditional dentures are complete-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
No more trouble with teeth-mo! Tradition wins-ja-mo!

My teeth are fixed and I can eat hard food again,[XENO:n ]
but everything tastes bland no matter what I eat-mo~.[XENO:n ]
I want a rich dish with strong ingredients-ja-mo~!

Gather 2 [System:Color name=item ]Crimson Sudachis[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Frontier Village.

Gather 2 [System:Color name=item ]Ruby Mangosteens[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Bloody Grog Sweat[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Makna Grogs in Makna Forest.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Frozen Aries Meat[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Aries on Valak Mountain.
Report to Fugofugo.

I'm amazed the dish turned out this rich-ja-mo.[XENO:n ]
Makes me want a drink with it-ja-mo~!

My dentures made yummy food taste yucky-ja-mo~.[XENO:n ]
So what if I eat[XENO:n ]
the yuckiest food[XENO:line ] Let's cook a yucky dish-ja-mo!

Obtain 3 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Dense Ansel Meat[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Eryth Ansels in Eryth Sea.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Grilled Moramora Heads[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Moramora on Valak Mountain.

Gather 4 [System:Color name=item ]Shin Newts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

Gather 3 [System:Color name=item ]Hard Spinach[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Fugofugo.

It smells horrible, but what a delicious taste![XENO:n ]
Old Fugo has a new joy in his remaining years-ja-mo~.

Sniff, sniff-sniff! At the altar Old Miga guards,[XENO:n ]
there's a sweet smell of alcohol-mo-na! If I ignore it,[XENO:n ]
I'll get drunk and fall into the water-da-mo-na~!
Investigate and resolve the source of the sweet smell.
Report to Migamiga.

What? Old Fugo brewed liquor at this altar-da-mo-na?[XENO:n ]
Fragrant liquor-da-mo-na. A drinking party-da-mo-na~!

What? Old Fugo brewed liquor at this altar-da-mo-na?[XENO:n ]
It's crude liquor-da-mo-na. Unforgivable-da-mo-na!

Old Fugo loves eating and drinking-ja-mo~.[XENO:n ]
Brewing liquor at the Sacred Altar was my dream-mo.[XENO:n ]
Bring what I need for the final batch-ja-mo!

Obtain 4 [System:Color name=item ]Walnut Grapes[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg, or[XENO:n ]
2 [System:Color name=item ]Bitter Kiwis[/System:Color] in Makna Forest.
Report to Fugofugo.

I'll brew it with Bitter Kiwi-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
I can't wait for the flavour after fermentation-ja-mo~.

I'll brew it with Walnut Grapes-ja-mo![XENO:n ]
That mature bitterness will turn very sweet-ja-mo~!

Yushi-sensei's leg really hurts, but he's putting on[XENO:n ]
a brave face[XENO:line ] I'm worried sick-mo.[XENO:n ]
Ask Medi-sensei to do something-mo.
Talk to Medi.
Talk to Yushi.
Place flowers on the Giant God's Leg.
Report to Yushi.
Report to Npa.

Yushi-sensei's leg has improved, and his feud[XENO:n ]
with Medi-sensei has eased a little-mo.

Flowers for the Giant God's corresponding body part...[XENO:n ]
Medi-sensei knows the old traditions too-mo.[XENO:n ]
Now hurry and offer them to relieve his leg pain-mo.

Near Kasharpa Falls on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
offer flowers at the offering spot.

At Tranquil Grotto on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
offer flowers at the offering spot.

At Viliera Hill on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
offer flowers at the offering spot.

On the south side of Gaur Plain on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
offer flowers at the offering spot.

Flowers are offered at 4 sites on the Giant God's Leg-mo.[XENO:n ]
Now talk to Yushi-sensei right away-mo.

I'm Medi, a doctor. Incorporating High Entia techniques[XENO:n ]
is the latest method, but[XENO:line ] Lately, people have complained[XENO:n ]
about the medicine. What's going on?
Talk to Puko who supplies the medicine.

Near Adversary's Cliff in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Felon Hirun[/System:Color].
Obtain [System:Color name=item ]High Entia Medicine[/System:Color].
Return to Puko.
Return to Medi.

Since the medicine was replaced, no complaints at all.[XENO:n ]
Technological progress is wonderful!

I'm scared, so scared-mo! If tiny Dabidabi dives[XENO:n ]
from this high, the wind will blow me into the forest-mo.[XENO:n ]
Moga! I must show courage here, and with Alinda[XENO:line ]!
Talk to Alinda.

Obtain 5 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Ekidno Jaw Gristle[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Ekidno in Eryth Sea.
Talk to Puko.
Complete the dive successfully.

I'm a little bigger than before[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
But Dabidabi and Alinda's love grew even bigger-mo!

Enlarging Seaweed[XENO:line ] With that,[XENO:n ]
Dabidabi should be able to dive safely-mo![XENO:n ]
Huh? Was I meant to take it to Alinda-mo?

Give the Enlarging Seaweed to Alinda[XENO:n ]
or Dabidabi.
Talk to Dabidabi.
Talk to Dabidabi.

I'll grow big with the Enlarging Seaweed-mo![XENO:n ]
Mo-mo~! I'm flying to Alinda-mo~!

I'll grow big with the Enlarging Seaweed-mo![XENO:n ]
Mo-mo~! Alinda, catch me-mo~!

Ngu-gugugu-gugugu, gugugu~[XENO:n ]
Ngu-gugugu-gugugu, gugugu~[XENO:n ]
I hear that from underground at night. It's scary-mo!
Seek out what is behind the strange voice.

Obtain 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Fuudi Camouflage[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Fuudi in Makna Forest.
Give them to Tati.
Report to Pique.

Instead of a ghost's song,[XENO:n ]
I heard a lullaby-mo[XENO:line ] Zzz...

Always cooking~ in the village~[XENO:n ]
Tati's melodies~ have got stale~[XENO:n ]
Gather exciting sounds~ from around the world-mo!
Obtain four kinds of items with 'Humming' in their names.
Obtain four kinds of items with 'Pop'n' in their names.
Report to Tati.

Melodies from a world I've never heard-mo![XENO:n ]
Tati's creativity is bursting with inspiration-mo!

Gather four kinds of Humming items for me~mo.[XENO:n ]
With Humming things~ a beautiful harmony~[XENO:n ]
might be born-mo!

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Humming Plums[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Humming Cabbages[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Humming Cats[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Humming Nettles[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

La la~! The harmony of the Humming things[XENO:n ]
lets me hear beautiful sounds of the world-mo!

Gather four kinds of Pop'n items for me~mo.[XENO:n ]
With Pop'n things~ a lively rhythm~[XENO:n ]
might be born-mo!

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Pop'n Stoneflies[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Pop'n Charcoal[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in the Ether Mine.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Pop'n Temps[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Pop'n Boxes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Frontier Village.

Lu lu~! The rhythm of the Pop'n things[XENO:n ]
lets me hear joyful sounds of the world-mo!

At this time of year, Makna fills with insects.[XENO:n ]
Chiri hates these bugs. I used to get rid of them,[XENO:n ]
but I can't do that anymore[XENO:line ]

Near Yellow Flower Field in Makna Forest,[XENO:n ]
defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Makna Elucas[/System:Color].
Go see Chiri.
Return to Rasha.

Thank goodness, the bugs Chiri hates are gone.[XENO:n ]
I hope Chiri can sleep soundly now.

We sisters roamed the world for the Nopon Merchant Company.[XENO:n ]
That creature took so much from us[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Please avenge my older sister[XENO:line ] Chiri's mother!

Near Ether Crystal Deposit in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Pillager Fuudi[/System:Color].
Return to Rasha.
Give Chiri the [System:Color name=item ]Cloth Shred[/System:Color].
Return to Rasha.

Chiri sees me as a mother[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Thank you. I owe you so much.

Those naughty turtles steal Dad's precious cargo.[XENO:n ]
Mum scolds Pachika whenever I do something naughty.[XENO:n ]
Go scold them just like that-mo![XENO:n ]

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Mount Tortas[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Pachika.

Maybe the turtles won't do bad things anymore-mo?[XENO:n ]
Next time, I want them to give Pachika a ride-mo!

Pachika's dad saw the Mythical Empress![XENO:n ]
But Pique and Kyuri said it was a lie[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Please catch the Mythical Empress for me-mo!
Ask Grelee where the Mythical Empress can be found.

Near Zax Guidepost on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain proof that the Mythical Empress exists.
Return to Pachika.

We couldn't catch it. What a shame-mo.[XENO:n ]
I'll show off the proof to Pique and Kyuri-mo~!

Miko is filling in for the absent chief,[XENO:n ]
but I'd like that careless Pelupelu to help-mo.[XENO:n ]
Please ask him to cooperate-mo.
Talk to Pelupelu.
Get advice from Miko.

Obtain 5 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Fresh Samon Belly[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Makna Samon in Makna Forest.

Show Pelupelu the Fresh Samon Belly[XENO:n ]
and speak to him.
Report to Miko.

Just as I expected, Pelupelu can't resist food-mo.[XENO:n ]
Even he is better than nobody-mo.

I'm bored-mo, bored bored, utterly bored-mo![XENO:n ]
Without anyone to talk to, Pelupelu might fall asleep-mo.[XENO:n ]
Hey, you lot! Come and chat with Pelupelu-mo!
Chat to Pelupelu in the early afternoon.
Chat to Pelupelu between 3pm and 6pm.
Chat to Pelupelu between 6pm and 9pm.
Chat to Pelupelu between 9pm and midnight.

While bored and watching Miko,[XENO:n ]
I realised Pelupelu should try harder too-mo!

I used to find all sorts of things a bother, but[XENO:n ]
watching Miko work makes Pelupelu feel he can too-mo.[XENO:n ]
I want to give my feelings form and show Miko-mo.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Lampus Glow Sticks[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Bunker Lampus in Colony 6.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Ansel Roasts[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Ansels on Valak Mountain.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Wet Rats[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report to Pelupelu.

I admire how Miko puts prayer above all else-mo.[XENO:n ]
Pelupelu will always keep watching Miko-mo.

Rapan heard the bridge in Makna was repaired-mo.[XENO:n ]
It's handy, but from across the river come Ashy Orugas,[XENO:n ]
that eat Nopon[XENO:line ] Our village is in grave danger-mo!

Near Nopon Arch in Makna Forest,[XENO:n ]
defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Ashy Orugas[/System:Color].
Report to Rapan.

What a relief-mo. Those giants can't appreciate[XENO:n ]
how cute Nopon are, so they're a real problem-mo.

Lupa's grandfather taught me many things-mo.[XENO:n ]
How is Colony 6, where Grandfather lives, doing now-mo?[XENO:n ]
Please deliver the Secret Nopon Elixir-mo.
Obtain ingredients for the Secret Nopon Elixir.
Report to Lupa.
Deliver the Secret Nopon Elixir to Tatsu.
Report to Lupa.

I'm glad Grandpa Tatsu is safe-mo.[XENO:n ]
Lupa will carry on his will and uncover Makna's secrets-mo!

'Drink Secret Nopon Elixir after a bath to live long-ja-mo~!'[XENO:n ]
That's what Grandfather always said-mo.[XENO:n ]
Gather all the ingredients for the elixir-mo!

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Abyss Waterstriders[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Claude Night Eyes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Jungle Claudes in Makna Forest.

Obtain 2 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Potent Grog Poison[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Poison Grogs in Satorl Marsh.

Once you've gathered the Secret Nopon Elixir ingredients,[XENO:n ]
bring them to Lupa-mo.

To open the door to the ruins in Makna,[XENO:n ]
we need the ancient documents scattered about Makna-mo.[XENO:n ]
Search every corner of Makna and find them-mo!

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Ancient Documents[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from various places in Makna Forest.
Report to Lupa.

The ancient documents eluded us for years[XENO:line ]![XENO:n ]
I'll decipher them, so wait a little-mo.

To open the ruins' door, you must offer a prayer-mo.[XENO:n ]
Pray with all your heart at the stone monument-mo![XENO:n ]
Then tell Lupa the ancient secret-mo.
Recite the prayer in front of Conqueror Agni's Tomb.
Investigate the inside of Conqueror Agni's Tomb.
Report to Lupa.

So there was a coffin deep in the ruins[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Right, let's open that coffin-mo.

Moving the heavy coffin lid requires special lubricant-mo.[XENO:n ]
Find the ingredients-mo!

Obtain 3 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Andos Water Grease[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Flavel Andos in Eryth Sea.

At Sap Cave in Makna Forest,[XENO:n ]
obtain 3 portions of [System:Color name=item ]Algora Sap[/System:Color].
Report to Lupa.

The high-quality Lubricant Oil is ready-mo.[XENO:n ]
Rub this into the seam of the coffin lid-mo!

It's finally time to open the coffin-mo[XENO:line ] Thank you[XENO:n ]
for helping me this far-mo. We don't know[XENO:n ]
what lies deep in the ruins. Be careful-mo!
Use the Lubricant Oil on the coffin.
Enter the space beyond the coffin and investigate.
Report to Lupa.

With the ruins explained, Lupa's curiosity is satisfied-mo![XENO:n ]
These records will go down in history-mo!

I want to meet the Nopon Sage at Great Makna Falls-mo.[XENO:n ]
He's an amazing Nopon who can do anything-mo.[XENO:n ]
You need an offering to meet him, so prepare one-mo!

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Juicy Laia Fins[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Chloro Laia in Eryth Sea.

Obtain 4 [System:Color name=item ]Meteor Bellcrickets[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.

Obtain 4 [System:Color name=item ]Floppy Sea Cukes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Report to Pique.

The offering is ready-mo! Slurp. Pique wants[XENO:n ]
to eat it, but I have to hold back-mo. Slurp!

The offering for the Nopon Sage is ready-mo![XENO:n ]
They say only children can see him, but surely[XENO:n ]
he'll meet Hero Riki and his companions-mo~!

Make the offering where you can see the[XENO:n ]
rainbow of Great Makna Falls.
Talk to the Nopon Sage.
Report to Pique.

Now I can eat lots of Bitter Kiwi, which I used to hate-mo![XENO:n ]
Thank you, Nopon Sage-mo!

Our precious timekeeping Time Mushrooms broke-da-mo-na![XENO:n ]
We'll lose track of day and night snack times-da-mo-na![XENO:n ]
It's a disaster-da-mo-na!
Fertilise the Time Mushroom on 2F.
Fertilise the Time Mushroom on 5F.
Fertilise the Time Mushroom on 8F.
Report to Migamiga.

Now we can tell both 3 pm and 3 am-da-mo-na.[XENO:n ]
The Nopon figure is saved-da-mo-na~!

We can't leave the capital as it is.[XENO:n ]
With Telethia roaming it, it'll become a dead city.[XENO:n ]
It pains me to strike down former friends, but[XENO:line ]

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Aora Telethia[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Imperial Capital Achamoth.
Report to Nero.

We're one step closer to restoring the capital.[XENO:n ]
Surely my friends have returned to the Giant God[XENO:line ]

Rebuilding the capital requires all sorts of materials.[XENO:n ]
But it seems there's no way to obtain machine parts.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials needed to restore the capital.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Refined Part M[/System:Color] units[XENO:n ]
from sleek flying Machine God Soldiers on the Fallen Arm.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]New Cylinders[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from silver defence units in the High Entia Tomb.
Report to Nero.

Most of the materials to restore the capital are ready.[XENO:n ]
If peace returns, we may be able to go back to the capital.

Without repairing the Ether Furnace Controls,[XENO:n ]
there's no prospect of rebuilding. Gather materials[XENO:n ]
for tools to repair them, and give them to Galba.

Obtain 10 [System:Color name=item ]Refined Part L[/System:Color] units[XENO:n ]
from Machine God Soldiers on the Fallen Arm.

Obtain 2 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Frost Glass[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Return to Galba.

You gathered the materials and gave them to Galba.[XENO:n ]
Restoration of the capital should progress a little now.

Use Galba's items to repair the Ether Furnace Controls.[XENO:n ]
With the Controls fixed and peace restored,[XENO:n ]
rebuilding the capital will no longer be a dream.
Mend the Ether Furnace Controls in Achamoth.
